idea: Browser extension that reads any webpage aloud in the voice of a historical figure the user picks, using a small on-device text-to-speech model, no cloud calls, free tier limited to 10 minutes per day.
customer: A casual web reader who wants pages read aloud while doing something else, drawn to this extension over a generic text-to-speech tool by the historical-figure voice novelty.
pieces: not decomposed -- moved here from problems/ during cleanup: its old pieces were hand-authored by Claude before the 'never predefine the pieces' rule was established. See BRIDGE.md and README.md.
